build.description: Compile and package the library jar

check.description: Non-mutating gate: compile all main and test sources (no formatter, no warnings-as-errors, no tests)

install.description: Install the library jar into the local Maven repository (so downstream projects can resolve it)

setup.description: One-time setup: activate the committed git hooks

tester.description: Run the interactive VenusScript REPL/tester (lives under test/)
